name: Furlbrow's Deed
summary: The Furlbrows are stranded near Westfall's border, and their land deed is in Defias hands. The paper bears Theodore and Verna Furlbrow's claim to their family farm, while the couple waits by their broken wagon.

sections.title: Stolen Land and Forged Claims
sections.body: The deed bears Theodore Furlbrow's signature and Verna's as well, securing their family farm in Westfall. When the Defias Brotherhood overran the region, bandits drove the couple from their home and carried the paper into Elwynn Forest. Notes on its back show they meant to copy it when forging claims to other properties. The Furlbrows lost their home and livelihood, then took to the road. Their wagon broke near the border, leaving them stranded.

faq.q: Why did the Defias steal the deed?
aliases: why did bandits want the deed
faq.answer: Notes on the parchment show the Defias meant to study its seal and signatures, then forge deeds to claim seized homesteads across Westfall.

faq.q: Who does this deed belong to?
faq.answer: The deed belongs to Farmer Theodore Furlbrow and his wife Verna, Westfall homesteaders driven from their farm by outlaws.

faq.q: Where can the Furlbrows be found?
faq.answer: You can find the couple just inside Westfall, beside their broken wagon on the main road from Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why do the Furlbrows still care about the deed if they fled?
aliases: why do they want deed back
faq.answer: The Furlbrows know Westfall is too dangerous for honest folk now, but keeping proof of ownership gives them hope of reclaiming their land if peace returns.

angles.text: As a human, you can see how the Defias have damaged civil order in the territories beside Stormwind, even by stealing simple property titles.
As an Alliance member, you can bring a little comfort to subjects displaced by the kingdom's shortage of soldiers.
